name: The Golf Club at Champions Circle
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (22704, formerly Doral Tesoro); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 71); its handicaps are used (OSM's have #1 and #3 both 13 and #10/#11 swapped). Its tee table rates a longer layout (Black 7027, Blue 6496, White 5841, Red 5143 yards, par 72) that matches none of the card's tees, so no ratings are given.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: the range tee.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it. Winter imagery, dull sand: fitted to the greens (fit_shift.py green).
